name: io.github.LetsFG/letsfg
title: LetsFG — Flights & Hotels
description: Search and book flights and hotels: hundreds of airlines, plus pay-later hotel rates.

environmentVariables.name: LETSFG_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Free token from `letsfg auth` (zero-amount card setup, nothing charged, 90-day token). Reaches both flights and hotels — the same card authorises both products.

environmentVariables.name: LETSFG_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Developer API key (prepaid credits) from letsfg.co/developers. Also reaches both flights and hotels; required for the account and payment tools.
